versos.hebraico: שִׁמְע֞וּ אֶת־הַדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה עֲלֵיכֶ֖ם בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל עַ֚ל כָּל־הַמִּשְׁפָּחָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֧ר הֶעֱלֵ֛יתִי מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם לֵאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Hear this word that Yahweh has spoken against you, children of Israel, against the whole family which I brought up out of the land of Egypt, saying:
controles.kjv: Hear this word that the Lord hath spoken against you, O children of Israel, against the whole family which I brought up from the land of Egypt, saying,
controles.livre: Ouvi esta palavra que o SENHOR fala contra vós, ó filhos de Israel, contra toda família que eu fiz subir da terra do Egito:

versos.hebraico: רַ֚ק אֶתְכֶ֣ם יָדַ֔עְתִּי מִכֹּ֖ל מִשְׁפְּח֣וֹת הָאֲדָמָ֑ה עַל־כֵּן֙ אֶפְקֹ֣ד עֲלֵיכֶ֔ם אֵ֖ת כָּל־עֲוֺנֹֽתֵיכֶֽם׃

controles.web: “You only have I chosen of all the families of the earth. Therefore I will punish you for all of your sins.”
controles.kjv: You only have I known of all the families of the earth: therefore I will punish you for all your iniquities.
controles.livre: Somente reconheci a vós mesmos de todas as famílias da terra; por isso punirei contra vós todas as vossas injustiças.

controles.web: Do two walk together, unless they have agreed?
controles.kjv: Can two walk together, except they be agreed?
controles.livre: Por acaso irão dois juntos, se não estiverem de acordo?

versos.hebraico: הֲיִשְׁאַ֤ג אַרְיֵה֙ בַּיַּ֔עַר וְטֶ֖רֶף אֵ֣ין ל֑וֹ הֲיִתֵּ֨ן כְּפִ֤יר קוֹלוֹ֙ מִמְּעֹ֣נָת֔וֹ בִּלְתִּ֖י אִם־לָכָֽד׃

controles.web: Will a lion roar in the thicket, when he has no prey? Does a young lion cry out of his den, if he has caught nothing?
controles.kjv: Will a lion roar in the forest, when he hath no prey? will a young lion cry out of his den, if he have taken nothing?
controles.livre: Rugirá o leão no bosque se não houver presa? Dará o leãozinho seu som desde sua cova, se nada tiver capturado?

versos.hebraico: הֲתִפֹּ֤ל צִפּוֹר֙ עַל־פַּ֣ח הָאָ֔רֶץ וּמוֹקֵ֖שׁ אֵ֣ין לָ֑הּ הֲיַֽעֲלֶה־פַּח֙ מִן־הָ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה וְלָכ֖וֹד לֹ֥א יִלְכּֽוֹד׃

controles.web: Can a bird fall in a trap on the earth, where no snare is set for him? Does a snare spring up from the ground, when there is nothing to catch?
controles.kjv: Can a bird fall in a snare upon the earth, where no gin is for him? shall one take up a snare from the earth, and have taken nothing at all?
controles.livre: Cairá o ave no laço na terra, se não houver armadilha para ela? Se levantará o laço da terra, se nada houver prendido?

versos.hebraico: אִם־יִתָּקַ֤ע שׁוֹפָר֙ בְּעִ֔יר וְעָ֖ם לֹ֣א יֶחֱרָ֑דוּ אִם־תִּהְיֶ֤ה רָעָה֙ בְּעִ֔יר וַיהוָ֖ה לֹ֥א עָשָֽׂה׃

controles.web: Does the trumpet alarm sound in a city, without the people being afraid? Does evil happen to a city, and Yahweh hasn’t done it?
controles.kjv: Shall a trumpet be blown in the city, and the people not be afraid? shall there be evil in a city, and the Lord hath not done it?
controles.livre: Tocará a trombeta na cidade, e o povo não se estremecerá? Haverá alguma calamidade  na cidade que o SENHOR não tenha feito?

versos.hebraico: כִּ֣י לֹ֧א יַעֲשֶׂ֛ה אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִ֖ה דָּבָ֑ר כִּ֚י אִם־גָּלָ֣ה סוֹד֔וֹ אֶל־עֲבָדָ֖יו הַנְּבִיאִֽים׃

controles.web: Surely the Lord Yahweh will do nothing, unless he reveals his secret to his servants the prophets.
controles.kjv: Surely the Lord God will do nothing, but he revealeth his secret unto his servants the prophets.
controles.livre: Certamente o Senhor DEUS não fará coisa alguma sem ter revelado seu segredo a seus servos os profetas.

versos.hebraico: אַרְיֵ֥ה שָׁאָ֖ג מִ֣י לֹ֣א יִירָ֑א אֲדֹנָ֤י יְהוִה֙ דִּבֶּ֔ר מִ֖י לֹ֥א יִנָּבֵֽא׃

controles.web: The lion has roared. Who will not fear? The Lord Yahweh has spoken. Who can but prophesy?
controles.kjv: The lion hath roared, who will not fear? the Lord God hath spoken, who can but prophesy?
controles.livre: Quando o leão ruge, quem não temerá? Quando o Senhor DEUS fala, quem não profetizará?

versos.hebraico: הַשְׁמִ֨יעוּ֙ עַל־אַרְמְנ֣וֹת בְּאַשְׁדּ֔וֹד וְעַֽל־אַרְמְנ֖וֹת בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם וְאִמְר֗וּ הֵאָֽסְפוּ֙ עַל־הָרֵ֣י שֹׁמְר֔וֹן וּרְא֞וּ מְהוּמֹ֤ת רַבּוֹת֙ בְּתוֹכָ֔הּ וַעֲשׁוּקִ֖ים בְּקִרְבָּֽהּ׃

controles.web: Proclaim in the palaces at Ashdod, and in the palaces in the land of Egypt, and say, “Assemble yourselves on the mountains of Samaria, and see what unrest is in her, and what oppression is among them.”
controles.kjv: Publish in the palaces at Ashdod, and in the palaces in the land of Egypt, and say, Assemble yourselves upon the mountains of Samaria, and behold the great tumults in the midst thereof, and the oppressed in the midst thereof.
controles.livre: Anunciai nos palácios de Asdode e nos palácios da terra do Egito, e dizei: Reuni-vos sobre os montes de Samaria, e vede os grandes tumultos no meio dela, e as opressões no meio dela.

versos.hebraico: וְלֹֽא־יָדְע֥וּ עֲשׂוֹת־נְכֹחָ֖ה נְאֻם־יְהוָ֑ה הָאֽוֹצְרִ֛ים חָמָ֥ס וָשֹׁ֖ד בְּאַרְמְנֽוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃פ

controles.web: “Indeed they don’t know to do right,” says Yahweh, “Who hoard plunder and loot in their palaces.”
controles.kjv: For they know not to do right, saith the Lord, who store up violence and robbery in their palaces.
controles.livre: E não sabem fazer o que é correto, diz o SENHOR; em seus palácios acumulam bens obtidos por violência e destruição.

versos.hebraico: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה צַ֖ר וּסְבִ֣יב הָאָ֑רֶץ וְהוֹרִ֤ד מִמֵּךְ֙ עֻזֵּ֔ךְ וְנָבֹ֖זּוּ אַרְמְנוֹתָֽיִךְ׃

controles.web: Therefore thus says the Lord Yahweh:  “An adversary will overrun the land; and he will pull down your strongholds, and your fortresses will be plundered.”
controles.kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; An adversary there shall be even round about the land; and he shall bring down thy strength from thee, and thy palaces shall be spoiled.
controles.livre: Portanto o Senhor DEUS diz assim: Um inimigo! Ele está ao redor da terra, e derrubará de ti a tua fortaleza, e teus palácios serão saqueados.

versos.hebraico: כֹּה֮ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָה֒ כַּאֲשֶׁר֩ יַצִּ֨יל הָרֹעֶ֜ה מִפִּ֧י הָאֲרִ֛י שְׁתֵּ֥י כְרָעַ֖יִם א֣וֹ בְדַל־אֹ֑זֶן כֵּ֣ן יִנָּצְל֞וּ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל הַיֹּֽשְׁבִים֙ בְּשֹׁ֣מְר֔וֹן בִּפְאַ֥ת מִטָּ֖ה וּבִדְמֶ֥שֶׁק עָֽרֶשׂ׃

controles.web: Thus says Yahweh:  “As the shepherd rescues out of the mouth of the lion two legs, or a piece of an ear, so shall the children of Israel be rescued who sit in Samaria on the corner of a couch, and on the silken cushions of a bed.”
controles.kjv: Thus saith the Lord; As the shepherd taketh out of the mouth of the lion two legs, or a piece of an ear; so shall the children of Israel be taken out that dwell in Samaria in the corner of a bed, and in Damascus in a couch.
controles.livre: Assim diz o SENHOR: Tal como o pastor livra da boca do leão duas pernas ou a ponta de uma orelha, assim os filhos de Israel que moram em Samaria serão livrados, com um canto da cama, e um pedaço do leito.

versos.hebraico: שִׁמְע֥וּ וְהָעִ֖ידוּ בְּבֵ֣ית יַֽעֲקֹ֑ב נְאֻם־אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י הַצְּבָאֽוֹת׃

controles.web: “Listen, and testify against the house of Jacob,” says the Lord Yahweh, the God of Armies.
controles.kjv: Hear ye, and testify in the house of Jacob, saith the Lord God, the God of hosts,
controles.livre: Ouvi e testemunhai contra a casa  de Jacó, diz o SENHOR Deus dos exércitos;

versos.hebraico: כִּ֗י בְּי֛וֹם פָּקְדִ֥י פִשְׁעֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עָלָ֑יו וּפָֽקַדְתִּי֙ עַל־מִזְבְּח֣וֹת בֵּֽית־אֵ֔ל וְנִגְדְּעוּ֙ קַרְנ֣וֹת הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ וְנָפְל֖וּ לָאָֽרֶץ׃

controles.web: “For in the day that I visit the transgressions of Israel on him, I will also visit the altars of Bethel; and the horns of the altar will be cut off, and fall to the ground.
controles.kjv: That in the day that I shall visit the transgressions of Israel upon him I will also visit the altars of Beth–el: and the horns of the altar shall be cut off, and fall to the ground.
controles.livre: Que no dia em que eu punir as transgressões de Israel sobre ele, também farei punição sobre os altares de Betel; e as pontas do altar serão cortadas, e cairão por terra.

versos.hebraico: וְהִכֵּיתִ֥י בֵית־הַחֹ֖רֶף עַל־בֵּ֣ית הַקָּ֑יִץ וְאָבְד֞וּ בָּתֵּ֣י הַשֵּׁ֗ן וְסָפ֛וּ בָּתִּ֥ים רַבִּ֖ים נְאֻם־יְהוָֽה׃ס

controles.web: I will strike the winter house with the summer house; and the houses of ivory will perish, and the great houses will have an end,”    says Yahweh.
controles.kjv: And I will smite the winter house with the summer house; and the houses of ivory shall perish, and the great houses shall have an end, saith the Lord.
controles.livre: E ferirei a casa do inverno com a casa do verão, e as casas de marfim se acabarão; e muitas casas terão fim,diz o SENHOR.
